Class GameMap

java.lang.Object
game.maps.GameMap
public class GameMap extends Object
A data model representing a playable level or map in the game.

This class stores all the static configuration required to load and play a level, including its visual background, the physical path enemies will follow, the player's starting economy (lives and money), and the exact composition and pacing of enemy waves.

    • HOVER_HEIGHT

      public static final double HOVER_HEIGHT

  • Constructor Details

    • GameMap

      public GameMap(String mapName, int mapLevel, javafx.geometry.Point2D[] waypoints, int startingMoney, int startingLives, EnemyType[][] waveSpawns, int[] waveSpawnIntervals, int[] waveSpawnSpacings)
      Constructs a new GameMap configuration.
      Parameters:
      mapName - The display name of the level.
      mapLevel - The index level of the map (1, 2, 3...).
      waypoints - An array of Point2D defining the physical path.
      startingMoney - The player's starting funds.
      startingLives - The player's starting health/lives.
      waveSpawns - A 2D array defining the enemies that spawn in each wave.
      waveSpawnIntervals - An array mapping the delay between individual spawns for each wave.
      waveSpawnSpacings - An array mapping the delay before the *next* wave begins.
